body:
### Summary

Following the merging, uv lock-check gave an error saying there were multiple matching packages. However, in checking for duplicates in the lockfile, I found no instances of that package. While the dependency was there, its package had disappeared. The error had me searching for the opposite problem.

Would a PR distinguishing a missing package entry from multiple matches be welcome?

### Reproducer (verified with Codex)

In an empty directory with Python 3.12 available:

```sh
cat > pyproject.toml <<'EOF'
[project]
name = "demo"
version = "1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = ["demo-util"]
EOF
cat > uv.lock <<'EOF'
version = 1
requires-python = ">=3.12"

[[package]]
name = "demo"
version = "1.0"
source = { virtual = "." }
dependencies = [{ name = "demo-util" }]
EOF
uv lock --check --offline --verbose
```

<details>
<summary>Command output (exit 2, local paths shortened)</summary>

```text

DEBUG Adding root workspace member: /example
DEBUG Skipping `pyproject.toml` in `/example` (no `[tool]` section)
DEBUG Searching for user configuration in: ~/.config/uv/uv.toml
DEBUG uv 0.13.9 (6b2d39dcc 2026-11-17 aarch64-apple-darwin)
DEBUG Found project root: /example
DEBUG No Python version file found in workspace: /example
DEBUG Using Python request `>=3.12` from `requires-python` metadata
DEBUG Checking for Python environment at: .venv
DEBUG Searching for Python >=3.12 in managed installations or search path
DEBUG Searching for managed installations at `~/.local/share/uv/python`
DEBUG Found managed installation `cpython-3.12.13-macos-aarch64-none`
DEBUG Found `cpython-3.12.13-macos-aarch64-none` at `~/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.12-macos-aarch64-none/bin/python3.12` (managed installations)
Using CPython 3.12.13
error: Failed to parse `uv.lock`
  cause: Dependency `demo-util` has missing `source` field but has more than one matching package
```

</details>

### Platform

macOS 26.5.1, arm64

### Version

uv 0.13.9 (6b2d39dcc)

### Python version

CPython 3.12.13
title: uv lock --check reports multiple matches when a dependency has no package entry
